Piano in 162 — Ivy Audio. Converted from the user-supplied Korg bank for local use.
Source product: https://ivyaudio.com/freebies
All PCM samples preserved losslessly as stereo FLAC, 44100 Hz / 16-bit.
5 velocity layers, 88-key coverage where supplied. Velocity thresholds reconstructed as 1-25, 26-50, 51-75, 76-100, 101-127.
Piano162-Close.sfz uses close pedal-off/on samples with CC64. Ambient uses pedal-off only.
This bank contains one take per layer; no second round robin is invented. PCG FX, release noises and original velocity thresholds are not recovered.
Global gain -9 dB and release 0.6 s are conversion settings.
This conversion does not establish a redistribution license for the samples; source files remain unchanged.
